summary: Integrating reviewed SDFormat behavior into the headless simulator. Next functional milestone is legacy-client clock/IMU publication; full packets remain unaccepted.

active.title: Adopt reviewed SDF semantics in the simulator
active.detail: Pin the tested SDF 1.6/1.7 subset and preserve atomic scene rejection using explicit non-frame pose validation. Regression tests and independent SDF-owner review are in progress.

active.title: Headless integration acceptance checklist
active.detail: Done: Bevy stepping, Rapier sphere/box state, IMU, SDF loader and CLI. Remaining: stable entity hierarchy, clock/pose/IMU transport with real C++ clients, offline Fuel resources, sensor rate/noise/reset qualification and equal-work C++ benchmark. No complete-slice claim.

SDF scene construction, full inertia and reset-safe IMU sampling

quality.note: Published OSRF attribution and Apache-2.0 guidance; executable bodies unchanged.
